rust_summary: chroma text (`Style::chroma`): an animated rainbow a mod puts on a `Text`.
doc_summary: chroma text: `Style::chroma` (`horizon_client::text::Chroma { size, speed, saturation, direction }`) sweeps an animated rainbow across a `Text`'s glyphs, their shadows and lines wherever the game draws it (HUD, tooltips, name tags, world primitives text), each glyph keeping its colour's brightness ([Chroma text](#chroma-text)). Bundles need "hooks": @API:chroma_text@.
